digest.title: Microsoft: October Windows Server updates break Exchange sign-in, mail flow
digest.tldr: Microsoft has confirmed that this month's Windows Server security updates are causing OWA sign-in and mail delivery issues on some Exchange Server systems.

digest.title: Ex-OpenAI worker accused of planting device had Saudi support says court filing
digest.tldr: The Saudi government did not immediately respond to BBC requests for comment.

digest.title: Microsoft fixes game, app crashes caused by recent Windows update
digest.tldr: Microsoft has resolved a bug that caused games and apps using AC-3 (Dolby Digital) audio decoding to crash after installing the September 2026 Windows 11 preview update (KB5124010).

digest.title: Microsoft fixes classic Outlook bug that hid Copilot buttons
digest.tldr: Microsoft has fixed a known issue that removed the Copilot Chat and Copilot buttons in the classic Outlook desktop mail client for some Windows users.

digest.title: NVIDIA Advances Agentic Security for Media, From European Public Service Broadcasting to Global Content Production
digest.tldr: At a creative industry event that took place today in Berlin — hosted in collaboration with Adobe, Bertelsmann, NVIDIA and UFA — the latest advancements in intelligent media were on display.
